method: Existing Google Cloud Translation draft with agent corrections and independent AI review; no human/native-speaker validation
notes: Independently compared all 194 fields with English, including indirect-control gameplay, economy, account/early-access and browser-save cautions, complete installation guidance and shared/accessibility/media UI.

Aligned food and swarm structures with native game உணவகம்/கூடு and explorers with சாரணர்கள். Corrected political-campaign and bank-cheque mistranslations, military-squad/colony confusion, imperative role descriptions, missing screenshot colors and limestone interpretation of lime green, and source/store labels.

Preserved exact product name, technical commands, filenames, screenshot counters and all placeholders. Tamil AI linguistic review does not establish human or native-speaker validation; native editorial refinement remains possible.
